name: Carter Smith
why: Single-subject Herald staff photograph, sharp focus, unambiguous caption naming him alone as he takes the senator's oath. Refiled from 2025-26 to 2026-27 in review on 27 September 2026: the caption dates the swearing-in to 22 September 2026, in the 2026 fall semester, and calls him a sophomore senator. He sat as a freshman senator in 2025-26, which is the only year his name then resolved in, so the merge filed the photograph a year early.
caption_quote: WKU Student Government Association Sophomore Senator Carter Smith gets sworn in to be a sophomore senator during SGA’s fourth meeting of the 2026 fall semester Tuesday, Sept. 22, 2026 in the SGA Chambers.

src.label: Herald, 23 Sep 2026 - SGA hears guest speaker, moves forward with improved bus tracking resolution
